Merging Ledger with hide-backend GoalStore, or Scheduler with hawking-serve batch Scheduler, would invent a third type. Documented in AUTHORITY_CENSUS.json two_real_authority_concepts.

within_hcli_py.why: Satisfaction (GOAL.md obligations) vs compilation (WorkUnits). Different identity spaces (G001 vs WorkUnit.id). DAG_CONSOLIDATION_DECISION.json.
PipelineClaim-shaped planner output vs GOAL.md obligation. Different fields and lifecycle. Renaming the pipeline type is a later source lane; merging them would forge VERIFIED.
Three schemas (mission goal receipt, grok-run receipt, verify sidecar). Shared the write primitive; did not merge schemas. Historical receipts cite the filenames.
WorkUnit state machine vs governor outcome vs human /status renderer. tui.render_status is transcript chrome (obsolete as an operator surface).
HCLI-py has one crash checkpoint: DagStore + mission state.json + MutationLock. Did not grow a Checkpoint class.
